user.title: Voice Alarms Setup
user.description: Configure voice alarms for your Assist satellites.

data_description.max_ring_time: How long the alarm rings before stopping automatically (1-120 minutes).
data_description.satellite_devices: Choose each Assist satellite once. Voice Alarms detects whether it exposes a supported on-device alarm API; supported devices ring locally, while all others use Home Assistant announcements.
data_description.sound: The sound played by Voice Alarms firmware-package devices. Other local alarm implementations use their own configured sound.

error.satellites_required: At least one satellite device must be selected.

abort.already_configured: Voice Alarms is already configured. Use the options flow to change settings.
